pages.title: Chain Breaker
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels$(br2)§lEffect: §r While holding the ~ key, mining breaks surrounding blocks of the same type in a chain; I/II/III levels cover 3×3×3, 5×5×5, and 9×9×9 areas. Each extra block costs 0.5 durability, up to 10 per swing.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with Ex Nihilo
